name: Node Menu Placer
description: Speeds up positioning a node in the menu by replacing the parent-link field with placement buttons.
project_description:
Node Menu Placer provides a new UI to facilitate the quick placement of nodes in complex menu structures. This module works with the Menu Link Weight module to update the menu settings of the node form.

 Features 
 Make it easier and faster to place nodes in complex menu structures from the node form.

 Post-Installation 
 Make sure a content type is configured with available menus in menu settings, the node menu settings section will now have Move to buttons.

 Additional Requirements 
 Menu Link Weight 

 Similar projects 
 The Menu Position module provides automated menu placement functionality based on rules.
